scope: Actual visual inspection of the concept-level additions at desktop and phone widths, with the recorded 820px DOM-boundary pass. Deeper disclosures opened where needed. Existing unrelated labs and historical native fits are not recertified.

sourceContinuity.explanation: Measurements retain the build tags and scope at which they were captured. The final source has passed independent reading and build checks. Unchanged visual components reuse those observations; subsequent prose corrections have the separately recorded final rendered-copy checks. This is not a claim that every old lab was rerun.

findings.message: Enlarged Wilson-interval labels. Removed stale prediction-first instructions and clarified validation selection and the zero-cost branch.

limits: No human learner trial or exhaustive screen-reader audit.
Browser text-zoom override was unavailable: the attempted shortcut did not change viewport or device pixel ratio, so zoom is not certified. Actual 390, 820 and 1280 pixel layouts were checked.
Full-viewport screenshots were inspected in the task; retained JSON records observations rather than duplicating all temporary images.
